# Halyard Health Europe

> > Halyard Health provides innovative medical solutions including surgical products, personal protective equipment (PPE), and sterilization systems for healthcare professionals across Europe.

The site offers comprehensive resources on infection prevention, sterile processing, and healthcare safety, featuring educational content aligned with standards from CDC, FDA, AAMI, ASTM, and professional organizations like CBSPD and IAHCSMM. Halyard Health, formerly part of Owens & Minor and now NYSE-listed, serves healthcare facilities with evidence-based solutions for surgical environments, hazardous drug handling, and pandemic preparedness.

## Key Topics

- Infection prevention and control
- Sterile processing and sterilization
- Personal protective equipment (PPE)
- Healthcare-associated infections (HAIs)
- Surgical gowns and barrier protection
- ASTM F2101 face mask standards
- USP <800> hazardous drug compliance
- CBSPD and IAHCSMM certification
- AAMI and AORN guidelines
- Sterilization wrap technology
- Cross-contamination prevention
- Pandemic preparedness
- Patient safety protocols
- Medical waste management
- Operating room safety

## Infection Prevention & Control

- [Minimizing Cross-Contamination Risk - 4 tips to reduce the risk of cross-contamination | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/hai/minimizing-cross-contamination-risk): CDC and Joint Commission tips for reducing cross-contamination in hospitals
- [Infection Inspection | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/hai-watch/infection-inspection): HAI prevention protocols: CLABSI and VAP control at Cabell Huntington
- [10 Questions to Ask Before You Stockpile | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/pandemic/10-questions-to-ask-before-you-stockpile): PPE stockpiling planning guide for pandemic and seasonal flu preparedness

## Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

- [3 Tips for Choosing the Right Face Mask](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/face-mask/choosing-the-right-face-mask-3-things-to-know): Face mask selection guide using ASTM ratings and performance standards
- [Is Your Surgical Gown Protecting You? What You Don't Know May Hurt You | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/surgical-gowns/is-your-surgical-gown-protecting-you): Surgical gown barrier protection standards: FDA and ANSI compliance guide
- [Mitigating the Risk of Glove Allergies in Healthcare](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/gloves/the-lesser-known-chemical-allergy-from-gloves-2): Healthcare glove allergy prevention: Type IV reactions and non-latex options
- [4 Things To Do Now to Get Ready for USP](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/chemotherapy/4-things-you-can-do-right-now-to-get-ready-for-usp): USP <800> compliance guide for hazardous drug handling and staff protection

## Sterile Processing & Sterilization

- [3 Design Considerations for Sterile Processing Departments | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/sterilization/3-design-considerations-for-sterile-processing-departments): SPD facility design guide following AAMI standards and workflow efficiency
- [SMS, SMMS, SMMMMS: Do More Layers Really Matter? | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/sterilization/sms-smms-smmms-do-more-layers-really-matter): Sterilization wrap layers: POWERGUARD technology vs. traditional meltblown

## Continuing Education Courses

- [ESP-DVD: Evaluating Sterilization Wrap: What You Need to Know | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/esp-dvd-evaluating-sterilization-wrap-what-you-need-to-know): CBSPD/IAHCSMM CE course on sterilization wrap evaluation and selection
- [ESP-DVD: It's a Wrap: Guidelines for Wrapping Techniques in SPD | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/esp-dvd-its-a-wrap-guidelines-for-wrapping-techniques-in-spd): SPD wrapping techniques CE course covering event-related sterility methods
- [ESP-DVD: Wet Packs: Strategies for Prevention and Resolution | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/esp-dvd-wet-packs-strategies-for-prevention-and-resolution-2): CE course on wet pack prevention and resolution strategies for CS-SPD
- [ESP-SG: Immediate-Use Steam Sterilization | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/esp-sg-immediate-use-steam-sterilization): IUSS/flash sterilization CE course for sterile processing professionals
- [ESP: We're Having an Inspection!!! How Do We Prepare? | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/esp-were-having-an-inspection-how-do-we-prepare-2): CE course on sterilization department inspection preparation and compliance

## Optional

- [Quality Patient Care Starts with Enlightened Self Care | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/articles/patient-safety/quality-patient-care-starts-with-enlightened-self-care): Healthcare worker wellbeing and burnout prevention for better patient safety
- [Environmental Dilemma: Safely Managing and Reducing the Impact of Medical Waste | HALYARD](https://halyardhealth.eu/courses/knowledge-network/environmental-dilemma-safely-managing-and-reducing-the-impact-of-medical-waste): CE course: medical waste management and environmental sustainability practices
